CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.current_user_app_role()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select role
  from public.app_profiles
  where user_id = auth.uid()
    and status = '사용'
  limit 1;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.current_user_employee_id()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select e.employee_id
  from public.app_profiles p
  join public.employees e on e.employee_name = p.display_name
  where p.user_id = auth.uid()
    and p.status = '사용'
  limit 1;
$function$

routines.name: current_user_can_access_task
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.current_user_can_access_task(target_task_id text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.task_history t
    left join public.output_history o on o.task_id = t.task_id
    where t.task_id = target_task_id
      and (
        t.owner_employee_id = public.current_user_employee_id()
        or o.owner_employee_id = public.current_user_employee_id()
      )
  );
$function$

routines.name: app_save_setting
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.app_save_setting(p_setting_key text, p_setting_value jsonb)
 RETURNS app_settings
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_row public.app_settings;
begin
  if not public.current_user_is_app_admin() then
    raise exception '관리자 권한이 필요합니다.' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  insert into public.app_settings (
    setting_key,
    setting_value,
    updated_at,
    updated_by
  )
  values (
    p_setting_key,
    p_setting_value,
    now(),
    auth.uid()
  )
  on conflict (setting_key) do update set
    setting_value = excluded.setting_value,
    updated_at = now(),
    updated_by = auth.uid()
  returning * into v_row;

  return v_row;
end;
$function$

routines.name: current_user_project_ids
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.current_user_project_ids()
 RETURNS SETOF text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  with current_profile as (
    select p.user_id, p.role, p.display_name
    from public.app_profiles p
    where p.user_id = auth.uid()
      and p.status = '사용'
    limit 1
  )
  select distinct pm.project_id
  from current_profile cp
  join public.employees e
    on e.employee_name = cp.display_name
   and coalesce(e.employment_status, '재직') <> '퇴사'
  join public.project_members pm
    on pm.employee_id = e.employee_id
   and pm.active_yn = 'Y'
  join public.projects pr
    on pr.project_id = pm.project_id
  where cp.role <> 'portal'
    and coalesce(pr.status, '진행') <> '종료'

  union

  select pr.project_id
  from current_profile cp
  join public.app_user_projects aup
    on aup.user_id = cp.user_id
  join public.projects pr
    on pr.project_name = aup.project_name
  where cp.role = 'portal'
    and coalesce(pr.status, '진행') <> '종료';
$function$

routines.name: app_admin_upsert_auth_account
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.app_admin_upsert_auth_account(p_login_id text, p_password text, p_display_name text, p_team_name text, p_subgroup_name text, p_role text, p_status text, p_projects text[] DEFAULT '{}'::text[])
 RETURNS TABLE(user_id uuid, email text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_login_id text := lower(trim(p_login_id));
  v_email text;
  v_user_id uuid;
  v_now timestamptz := now();
begin
  if not public.current_user_is_app_admin() then
    raise exception '관리자 권한이 필요합니다.';
  end if;

  if v_login_id !~ '^[a-z0-9._-]{2,50}$' then
    raise exception '아이디는 영문, 숫자, 마침표, 밑줄, 하이픈만 사용할 수 있습니다.';
  end if;

  if coalesce(trim(p_display_name), '') = '' then
    raise exception '직원명을 입력하세요.';
  end if;

  if p_role not in ('admin', 'operator_all', 'operator_no_profit', 'portal', 'worker') then
    raise exception '올바르지 않은 권한입니다.';
  end if;

  if p_status not in ('사용', '중지') then
    raise exception '올바르지 않은 상태입니다.';
  end if;

  v_email := v_login_id || '@users.agency-ops.app';

  select u.id
    into v_user_id
  from auth.users u
  where lower(u.email) = v_email
  limit 1;

  if v_user_id is null then
    if coalesce(p_password, '') = '' or length(p_password) < 6 then
      raise exception '신규 계정의 초기 비밀번호는 6자 이상 입력하세요.';
    end if;

    v_user_id := extensions.gen_random_uuid();

    insert into auth.users (
      instance_id,
      id,
      aud,
      role,
      email,
      encrypted_password,
      email_confirmed_at,
      confirmation_sent_at,
      confirmed_at,
      raw_app_meta_data,
      raw_user_meta_data,
      is_super_admin,
      created_at,
      updated_at
    )
    values (
      '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',
      v_user_id,
      'authenticated',
      'authenticated',
      v_email,
      extensions.crypt(p_password, extensions.gen_salt('bf')),
      v_now,
      v_now,
      v_now,
      '{"provider":"email","providers":["email"]}'::jsonb,
      '{}'::jsonb,
      false,
      v_now,
      v_now
    );
  elsif coalesce(p_password, '') <> '' then
    if length(p_password) < 6 then
      raise exception '변경 비밀번호는 6자 이상 입력하세요.';
    end if;

    update auth.users
      set encrypted_password = extensions.crypt(p_password, extensions.gen_salt('bf')),
          email_confirmed_at = coalesce(email_confirmed_at, v_now),
          confirmed_at = coalesce(confirmed_at, v_now),
          updated_at = v_now
    where id = v_user_id;
  end if;

  insert into public.app_profiles (
    user_id,
    login_id,
    display_name,
    team_name,
    subgroup_name,
    role,
    status
  )
  values (
    v_user_id,
    v_login_id,
    trim(p_display_name),
    nullif(trim(coalesce(p_team_name, '')), ''),
    nullif(trim(coalesce(p_subgroup_name, '')), ''),
    p_role,
    p_status
  )
  on conflict (user_id) do update set
    login_id = excluded.login_id,
    display_name = excluded.display_name,
    team_name = excluded.team_name,
    subgroup_name = excluded.subgroup_name,
    role = excluded.role,
    status = excluded.status,
    updated_at = now();

  delete from public.app_user_projects
  where app_user_projects.user_id = v_user_id;

  insert into public.app_user_projects (user_id, project_name)
  select v_user_id, trim(assigned.project_name)
  from unnest(coalesce(p_projects, '{}')) as assigned(project_name)
  where nullif(trim(assigned.project_name), '') is not null
  on conflict do nothing;

  return query select v_user_id, v_email;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_public_daily_status()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
 SET statement_timeout TO '15s'
AS $function$
  with eligible as (
    select t.*, p.client_name, p.project_name
    from public.task_history t join public.projects p on p.project_id = t.project_id
    where p.public_daily_enabled = true and coalesce(p.status, '') <> '종료' and t.due_date is not null
  ), allocations as (
    select t.client_name, t.project_name, t.due_date, coalesce(o.owner_employee_id, t.owner_employee_id) as employee_id,
      greatest(0, coalesce(o.quantity,0) * coalesce(o.standard_hours_per_unit,0) *
        case t.photo_type when '화보컷' then 0.5 when '비화보컷' then 1.5 else 1 end) as hours
    from eligible t join public.output_history o on o.task_id = t.task_id
    union all
    select t.client_name, t.project_name, t.due_date, t.owner_employee_id, coalesce(t.planned_hours,0)
    from eligible t where not exists (select 1 from public.output_history o where o.task_id = t.task_id)
  ), grouped as (
    select a.client_name as client, a.project_name as project, a.due_date::date as "dueDate",
      md5(coalesce(a.employee_id,'__unassigned__')) as key,
      coalesce(e.employee_name,'미배정') as name, sum(a.hours) as hours
    from allocations a left join public.employees e on e.employee_id = a.employee_id
    group by a.client_name,a.project_name,a.due_date,a.employee_id,e.employee_name
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(g) order by g."dueDate",g.project,g.name),'[]'::jsonb) from grouped g;
$function$
